transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, my family says I’ve been doing too much lately. I don’t really see it that way. I feel like I’m the one with the energy to get things done — handling the move, rebuilding the garage the right way, helping organize things at church, and still keeping up at work, showing the younger guys how the job ought to be done.
Have you been hearing voices or seeing things that other people don’t seem to?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t been hearing voices or seeing things like that.
Have you ever had a period where you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I’ve had rough stretches like anybody, but I don’t know that I’d call it depressed most of the day every day for two weeks. Nothing I can clearly point to like that.
For at least one full week, have you felt unusually energetic or driven most of the day nearly every day?

Yes. For at least a week, probably longer, I’ve felt like I can’t sit still. I’ll sit in a chair and after a few minutes I’m back up sorting boxes, measuring things in the garage, loading tools, or driving back to the old place. It’s like my body’s got a motor in it.
Have you ever had a time in your life when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I don’t know that I can say that. I’ve had bad days and stretches where I felt down, sure, but I can’t clearly remember being depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for a full two weeks.
Have you been hospitalized because of this high-energy period?
I’m not sure how to answer that. I haven’t really thought of it that way. I don’t have a clear hospital stay I can point to because of it.
During this high-energy period, has it caused serious problems in your life?

Yes, it has. I got pulled from work after a safety incident, and that’s not something small in my line of work. And at home… my wife and family don’t really trust me right now with decisions about money, driving, or the move. They feel like things got out of hand, and honestly, they did.
Before this current high-energy period, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt unusually high-energy or driven like this?
I’m not really sure. Nothing stands out to me like this. I’ve had times where I was busy or motivated, but not something I’d clearly call the same as what’s been happening now.
Before this current episode, was there ever another time in your life when you felt unusually high or full of energy for several days in a row?
Not that I can really remember. I’ve had busy stretches, sure, but I can’t point to another time before this where I felt unusually high or full of energy for days like this.
During this high-energy period, have you had a belief that other people said was not true or did not make sense?
I don’t think so. People have told me some of my ideas or decisions didn’t make sense, but I don’t know that I believed something that just wasn’t true like that.
Before this current period, have you ever had another episode where you felt unusually energetic or driven like this?
I don’t really have another episode to point to before this. I’ve had times I was working hard or busy, but not where I felt unusually driven like this.
During this high-energy period, have you felt especially important or powerful in a way that other people said was clearly unrealistic?
No, I don’t think so. I may have felt more confident than usual, but I don’t remember thinking I was especially important or powerful like that, or having people tell me it was clearly unrealistic.
During this high-energy period, have you felt unusually suspicious that people were trying to harm you or plot against you?
No, I wouldn’t say that. I haven’t felt like people were out to hurt me or plotting against me. I might get irritated with people, but not suspicious like that.
During this high-energy period, did you ever hear a voice when no one was there speaking?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices when nobody was there talking.
During this high-energy period, did you ever become convinced of something that other people said was definitely not true?
No, I don’t think so. I can’t think of anything I was convinced of that other people said was flat-out not true.
